notes: oka.com/uk 301-redirects to https://www.oka.com/ which serves GBP/UK pricing (no separate /uk path exists) - treated as the UK storefront per the assignment. robots.txt has a generic 'User-agent: *  Allow: /' policy with no Claude-specific disallow, so no policy_opt_out. Discovery: fetched the Shopify collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 318 collection URLs) and scanned every handle for seasonal/holiday vocabulary (christmas, xmas, halloween, diwali, easter, valentine, thanksgiving, new-year, holi, rakhi, eid, navratri, festive, holiday, advent, wreath, bonfire, stocking, santa, etc.); also checked the rendered main-nav mega menu (Cushions/Furniture/Gifts/Homeware/Icons/Inspiration/Lighting/New/Rooms/Sale submenus - none currently link a seasonal branch, it is early September and the site is between seasonal pushes) and ran an on-site search for 'christmas' (20 product hits, no additional PLPs beyond the ones already found in the sitemap). Only 3 genuine seasonal PLPs exist, no shared parent/grouping node - each is a flat top-level collection. Counts are the site's own rendered pagination total (data-graphene-hc-el=pagination-total, populated by the site's Advanced Commerce/Graphene merchandising widget after JS render; Shopify's raw /products.json endpoint was cross-checked but returns larger, inflated collection-membership counts (114/89/210) that do not match what a shopper sees, consistent with the project's known Shopify products_count unreliability - the rendered pagination total was used instead). christmas-decorations (74 items) and seasonal-decorations (52 items) share an identical <title> tag 'Christmas & Seasonal Decorations | OKA' and heavy product-title overlap (baubles, hanging decorations, festive candle holders, faux berry stems) but are confirmed distinct live collections - different Shopify collection IDs (rid 623364964619 vs 623364112651), different meta descriptions ('Enhance your Yuletide cheer with beautiful embellishments' vs 'Tastefully decorate your home with our luxury seasonal decorations'), and different rendered counts (74 vs 52) - so kept as two separate rows rather than merged as a duplicate (Rule 0.6 does not apply since counts/facets are not identical). Excluded as non-seasonal: /collections/ornaments ('Decorative Ornaments & Objets d'Art', 14 items - a generic year-round decorative-accessories category, not Christmas-specific despite containing some ornament-style products - Seasonal product type != Seasonal category, rule 5/6); /collections/black-friday ('Black Friday Sale' - pure promotional sale page, rule 4); /collections/anniversary-gifts, /collections/housewarming-gifts, /collections/gifts-for-the-host (non-seasonal gift occasions, not holiday-associated). No Halloween, Diwali, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Mother's/Father's Day, or any Indian-festival category exists anywhere in the site's collection taxonomy as of 2026-09-03.
